sloka: सुग्रीवमन्त्रिते युक्तौ मम चापि हिते रतौ ।अर्हतो विविधां पूजां त्वत्कृते वै हरीश्वर ।। ७.३९.१८ ॥
transliteration: sugrīvamantrite yuktau mama cāpi hite ratau ।arhato vividhāṁ pūjāṁ tvatkṛte vai harīśvara ।। 7.39.18 ॥

translations.english: O lord of monkeys, Angada and Hanuman, being engaged in your counsel and devoted to my welfare, indeed deserve various honors for your sake.
